LanguageData.RHA_FrostTrial030_root.label: Break the first ice
LanguageData.RHA_FrostTrial030_root.description: Threat: Frozen enemies reduce damage by at most 20% and move slower; phases last at least 30 seconds. Answer: Actual damage reaching 20% of maximum torso health forces an 8-second thaw; saving burst for natural thaw also works. Reward: Thawed enemies take 25% more damage; same-kind exposure uses the stronger value. Cost: Ignoring phases spends burst during the defended freeze. Arrangement: Anchor break; Locked impact. New first clears teach counters; refinements deepen coordination. Roles change no faster than every 30 seconds. Locked attacks never track; ordinary attacks and early kills work. Existing finite roster retained.
